name: Zelotus
bio: Zelotus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors records the poet's date as unknown.
This archive carries the 2 epigrams ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 30, 31).

poems.title: Book IX, 30
poems.author: Zelotus
poems.text: I am a pine-tree broken by the wind on land. Why do you send me to the sea, a spar shipwrecked before sailing ?

poems.title: Book IX, 31
poems.author: Zelotus
poems.text: Way, shipwrights, do ye entrust to the sea this pine, which the strong south-wester tore up by the roots from the mountain side? I shall make no lucky hull at sea, I, a tree which the winds hate. On land I already experienced the ill-fortune of the sea.
